title: Extract reusable organic region generation and motion
body: Extract the painting region geometry and coordinated slow motion into an independently published component. Preserve varied region size, density, and flow. Compare baseline and extracted frames at identical settings/times and inspect animation before publishing. Keep original saved scenes. Publish, commit, independently review, and merge before beginning the next extraction.

title: Extract reusable region hatching effect
body: Extract per-region hatch angle, spacing, width, curvature, irregularity and crosshatching, including no-hatch regions, as a reusable Library part. Preserve region-specific styling and support compositional reuse. Capture matching before/after frames and inspect animation; resolve visual regressions. Publish, commit, review, and merge before next extraction.

title: Extract reusable region style transitions
body: Extract region identity-driven color/hatch variation and smooth split transitions into a reusable Library part. Preserve tracer-driven cuts and the approved uneven patches. Compare identical-time before/after frames and animation, then publish, commit, review and merge.

title: Extract reusable watercolor color and pigment effects
body: Extract animated palette fields, moving warm spots, pigment bleeding and watercolor blending into reusable Library parts with compositional inputs/outputs. Preserve approved palette and tracer interaction. Compare before/after at matching settings/times and animation. Publish, commit, review and merge before next extraction.

title: Extract reusable organic boundary line effect
body: Extract tinted-white region boundaries, pressure/thickness variation and hand-drawn irregularity into a reusable Library effect. Preserve the approved painting appearance. Compare before/after frames and motion, publish, commit, review and merge.

title: Extract reusable composition and motion phrasing
body: Extract controls for large versus fine detail, spatial rhythm, tension/release and quiet areas into a reusable component usable by the painting parts. Preserve current coherent movement without extra stylistic changes. Compare matching frames and animation before publishing, committing, reviewing and merging.
